craft_notes: Sthāyin: memorize-whole (cosmos as palate). Rows: row 3 (at-once→bliss may be). Close: may be (optative — bliss as granted state). Rejected: 'visualize' — killed: remember kept (smara — memory not image); 'bliss-drunk' — killed: full of kept (bhara as fill).

lines: All world or own body, with own bliss filled, remember:
at once with own nectar — full of supreme bliss may be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ jagat svadehaṃ vā svānandabharitaṃ smaret | yugapat svāmṛtenaiva parānandamayo bhavet

reads_against.argmap: What is remembered at once? → Remembering filled with own bliss/nector, one becomes full of supreme bliss.
c1_essence: Own bliss-filled world remembered: own nectar, supreme bliss.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta charged with vīra (wonder armed with intensity)
